This compound is implicated in the regulation of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain, indicating a potential mechanism by which Cochliomycin A, (rel)- may influence the activity of this enzyme. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for cytochrome c4 in mediating the interaction between Cochliomycin A, (rel)- and L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain, suggesting a broader biological context in which these interactions occur.
